description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring smooth oval shell with conspicuously raised eye towers near the head centre.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：光滑椭圆甲，头部中央附近竖高眼柱。

scientific_scope.en: Genus-level planning study grounded in a named taxon source; reconstructed or simplified components remain artistic interpretations.
scientific_scope.zh: 依据具名分类单元来源进行属级规划；补全及简化结构仍属于复原或美术解释。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is smooth oval shell with conspicuously raised eye towers near the head centre; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以光滑椭圆甲，头部中央附近竖高眼柱为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish smooth oval shell with conspicuously raised eye towers near the head centre in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以光滑椭圆甲，头部中央附近竖高眼柱搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Named source supports the principal form. Species-level dimensions, missing structures and soft tissues still require a selected specimen reference.
reference_notes: Asaphus kowalewskii, PDF page 13, Ordovician; long eye stalks. No exact coexistence is implied.

sources.title: Trilobite Hall of Fame: Best of the Best
sources.supports: Asaphus long eye stalks (PDF p13), Dicranurus curved horns (p31), Erbenochile enlarged eyes (p38); named specimen ages. Other pictured taxa remain gated unless their forms are individually matched.
